sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: I know why they sent me here. They want me to [b]calm down[/b], and go back pretending like everything is fine. But I figured out it's worth a shot anyway.

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: My brother had his arm fractured, and [b]I knew I had to do something[/b], and... make them pay for it.

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: I [b]watched those videos[/b] from the event online, I just don't know what to do...

choices.text: Sounds really rough, I hope your brother's okay, but I'd like to hear more about what happened from you.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: Oh.. thanks a lot.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: No one in (community name) seems to support me doing this.

choices.text: Well, they definitely did something really terrible, but I think you're doing the right thing.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: Yeah, right? But no one in (community name) seems to support my idea.

choices.text: You've watched the videos quite a bit. What was it about them that convinced you that the group was responsible?

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: I mean it was obvious once you see it, there are a lot of these videos that shows the group doing things to our community.

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: Everyone there just seems to [b]not want me to[/b], I mean [b]just look what they did to my bro[/b].

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: That person definitely pushed him on purpose while trying to get through the crowd, [b]I have to find this guy and their gang somehow[/b]...

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: That's why I'm here in the first place, *sigh*...

choices.text: Hey, maybe we can try figuring things out together? A problem doesn't necessarily need retaliating to be solved.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: I guess you're right, but what can I even do at this point?

choices.text: Well, they are definitely wrong. You're right to be feeling this way.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: Mhm, I don't really care about what they say anyway, the people who did this to my bro has to get something back.

choices.text: What makes you think the person deliberately pushed your brother?

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: Well I also watched the videos dozens of times, it's very clear that the person has pushed him, he even looked at him apathetically.

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: But what can I do now... it's like [b]I'm all on my own now[/b].

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: Even when there is something I can do, [b]I actually don't know if I would be able to[/b]...

choices.text: Maybe you should think if fighting back is even worth it.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: ...Maybe.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: But those videos have proven it, I don't know how else they can be wrong.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: I need some time to think... I'll see you next time.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: I think I know what to do, those videos have proven it, I just don't know how to get there yet...

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: For now I'll need some time.

choices.text: Well, I believe you can do it, and you have those videos too.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: I'll try I guess. Those videos are there to back me up.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: I guess I'll see you the next session then.

choices.text: What do you think is most important to you?

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: My brother, and our community. The things they've done, I don't want that to happen to us again.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: The videos proves what's real, and they've been doing to us.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: I need some time to think... I'll go for now.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: Well... my brother. But I'm not sure what entirely to do about this.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: The videos are real though, but I can't just see what's in front of me a lie.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: I have to think this through, then... I'll see you again.
